metadata.event: Royal Fair of the Assumption & Pentecost

castleElements.name: Donżon (Romanesque Round Keep)
castleElements.description: Limestone cylinder keep built in 13th c., 3m thick walls, refuge tower.

castleElements.name: Kaplica Trójcy Świętej (Royal Holy Trinity Chapel)
castleElements.description: Two-tier Gothic brick chapel commissioned by Casimir the Great / Jagiełło with Ruthenian-Byzantine frescoes.

castleElements.name: Dwór Królewski (Royal Palace Hall)
castleElements.description: Gothic royal residential hall hosting King Jagiełło and royal court during the 1392 Fair.

civicLandmarks.name: Ratusz Miejski (Old Town Hall)
civicLandmarks.description: Gothic brick town hall with clock tower, ground floor council arcades, battlemented attic and 4 corner turrets.

civicLandmarks.name: Szmatruz (Royal Cloth & Bread Hall)
civicLandmarks.description: Cloth hall with 22 brick pillars, covered central aisle, 16 royal fair vendor stalls.

civicLandmarks.name: Kościół św. Michała Archanioła (Collegiate Parish Church)
civicLandmarks.description: Magnificent Gothic collegiate church towering over the promontory with 60-meter spire.

civicLandmarks.name: Klasztor Dominikanów (Dominican Friary & Basilica)
civicLandmarks.description: Founded in 1342 by Casimir the Great, sanctuary of the True Cross Relic.

fairEvents.name: Arrival of Hungarian Wine Caravans
fairEvents.description: Thirty ox-drawn wagons carrying Tokaji wine, copper ingots, and dried prunes pass through Kraków Gate after paying the royal bridge toll.

fairEvents.name: Guild Cloth Inspection at the Szmatruz
fairEvents.description: The Senior Alderman of the Weavers and Royal Bailiff inspect Flemish broadcloth rolls with lead seal stamps.

fairEvents.name: Royal Herald Proclamation
fairEvents.description: A mounted royal herald from King Władysław Jagiełło announces toll exemptions for merchants travelling through Sandomierz and Lublin.

fairEvents.name: Civic Curfew Bell & Gate Locking
fairEvents.description: Collegiate bells toll nine times. Heavy oak gates and iron portcullises are bolted shut by municipal halberdiers.
